preconditions.description: The number of workers n must be between 1 and 5000.
The numerator a and denominator b of the parameter k must satisfy 1 <= a <= b <= 100000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' and c not in 'trygub' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of lowercase English letters excluding 't', 'r', 'y', 'g', 'u', and 'b'.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the number of obtainable job categories followed by the categories in lexicographical order.
